title: BlockSchema
description: BlockSchema describes the typed document nodes that every Dispatch client supports. It is the shape of packages/envoy/internal/dispatch/pmdoc/schema/blocks.json, the one block schema the document service embeds, serves at GET /api/v1/schema/blocks, and holds every stored document to.

version.description: Version is the schema version clients present when they admit a document.

types.description: Types is every typed block the schema declares.

BlockTypeSchema.description: BlockTypeSchema describes one typed ProseMirror block.

name.description: Name is the directive name the block is written as in markdown.

render.description: Render names who draws the block. Only the host does.

attributes.description: Attributes is the block's attributes, in the order this file declares them: the order the server writes them in a typed block's markdown, and the order every client reads them back in. A JSON object holds no order of its own, so the decoder keeps the keys in the order the source text carries them and the encoder writes them back in that order.

BlockAttributeSchema.description: BlockAttributeSchema describes one typed block attribute.

choices.description: Choices is the values an `enum` attribute may hold. No other kind carries it.

default.description: Default is the value a block of this type carries when its markdown writes none. An attribute without one is left out of a block that does not hold it.

server.description: Server marks an attribute the server owns: a client never writes it, and an agent's markdown never carries it.

targets.description: Targets limits a `block[]` attribute to blocks of the named types (a typed block the schema declares, or a built-in block the link graph holds); absent or empty, it points at any block. No other kind carries it.

BlockAttributeScope.description: BlockAttributeScope limits where a `block[]` attribute may point. `document` points only at a block of the document holding it: a plan task's `needs` orders the tasks of one plan, so it names a task of its own document and never another plan's. An attribute declaring no scope points at a block of its document's own issue or of any issue above it, which every pointer is held to anyway. It is a server rule, which the server checks on a write it accepts (pmdoc's CheckBlockPointers), not something an editor draws, so declaring it leaves the schema version alone.

BlockContentRule.description: BlockContentRule describes the block children a typed node may contain.

BlockAttributeKind.description: BlockAttributeKind is the kind of value a typed block attribute holds. A `block[]` attribute points at blocks: canonical block references (parseBlockPointerValue in @legion/contracts' dispatch-block-ref.ts), each making an edge of the attribute's name.
